review: NRS 484B.420 specifies left arm extended beyond the left side: horizontal for left turn or reentry, upward for right turn, downward for stop or decrease. Frozen NRS 484B.769 permits the separate horizontal right-arm method for a right turn by a covered rider on a roadway.
scope_limit: This public source completes the referenced-method planning text; original actor, roadway, arm pose and pixels still require capture and independent review. NRS 484B.769 itself does not establish a signal timing duration or a rule that every right turn must signal.
